subject: Vendor enrollment: Ariba/Coupa field harmonization + MSA redline
messages:
From: Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal enrollment & PO field questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to get Novamed set up in either Ariba or Coupa (we're okay with either, preference depends on PO format support). Before we start the portal registration, a couple of asks from procurement to avoid back-and-forth later: 

- Can you confirm the exact PO fields Redwood requires for automated PO ingestion (line-level item code, unit_of_measure, tax_jurisdiction, GL account mapping)? We attached a CSV with our current export sample.
- We typically need an explicit contract clause in the order form about acceptance criteria for electronic POs (to match our ERP). Any chance legal can confirm the order form language you'll attach to the vendor profile?
- Our IAM team will need the on-boarding instructions for Ariba/Coupa SSO and the account admin role names.

I've attached our PO export sample and the initial enrollment questionnaire. Please loop in legal/ops for the MSA/order-form language.

Att: PO_field_mapping_example.csv, enrollment_questionnaire.pdf

Regards,
Carla Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
Novamed Health Systems

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment & PO field questions

Carla — thanks, received. Quick note to acknowledge and to outline next steps so we're aligned: 

1) Legal/Contracts (Marissa) will review the order-form language and return a redline of the MSA/order form. Expect that by EOD Wednesday. If there are specific acceptance criteria you want captured verbatim, paste them into a short doc and we'll add.
2) Ops (Vivek + Marcus) will map your PO sample to our ingestion schema. We typically require the following minimal fields for automated ingestion: PO_number, line_item_id, sku, qty, uom, unit_price, tax_amount, tax_jurisdiction, ship_to_code. We'll highlight any mismatches in the CSV.
3) SSO and admin provisioning: we'll send Ariba/Coupa admin setup instructions and a small checklist for your IAM.

I'm attaching the current MSA with our preferred order-form language (MSA_redline_v1.docx). Marissa — can you focus on the acceptance criteria and the electronic PO clause? Vivek/Marcus — can you start a field mapping pass and return a mapping table with any optional fields that we can ignore safely?

Thanks — I'll coordinate a short call if we need to queue a joint session with your ERP folks.

Best,
Tessa
Head of Partnerships Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_redline_v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@novamed.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment & PO field questions

On Mon, Sep 20, 2027 at 10:03 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'm attaching the current MSA with our preferred order-form language (MSA_redline_v1.docx). Marissa — can you focus on the acceptance criteria and the electronic PO clause?

Thanks, Tessa — looped in. Carla — I reviewed your questionnaire and the PO sample. A few points from Legal/Commercial: 

- We're proposing a small insertion in the order form that clarifies "electronic PO acceptance" as: "Vendor shall be deemed to have accepted an electronic purchase order upon successful ingestion and a corresponding order acknowledgement signal from Vendor's system." If that language matches your ERP behavior we'll include in the next redline.
- There are two redline asks I want to highlight for your team to consider: (1) limitation of liability cap remains at standard $2M; (2) payment terms: Redwood uses Net-45 by default, but we can update to Net-30 for Novamed as part of the enrollment if procurement confirms.

I'll attach a second pass redline (MSA_redline_v2.docx) with the electronic PO clause and the order-form attachment flagged for your review. Also attaching a quick field mapping comments sheet — Marcus, please confirm the ingestion tolerances (e.g., tax_jurisdiction vs tax_code).

Att: MSA_redline_v2.docx, PO_field_mapping_comments.pdf

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@novamed.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment & PO field questions

Carla / team — final note from Ops after mapping pass (see attached CSV conversion):

- We can auto-ingest your PO file with two minor transforms: (1) map your "item_code" to our "sku"; (2) normalize "uom" to our canonical set (EA, BOX, LBS). I've included a script stub and an example mapping in PO_field_mapping_example.csv.
- Tax_jurisdiction: we accept either a tax_jurisdiction code (preferred) or a combined tax_name/tax_rate pair — please indicate which your system can reliably provide.
- Order form currency: Redwood defaults to USD on the order form; we can set the currency per-account if Novamed confirms preferred billing currency.

Next steps summary (who/when):
- Legal (Marissa): finalize MSA + order-form clause -> deliver MSA_redline_v2.docx (EOD Wed).
- Ops (Marcus + Vivek): finalize field mapping + provide portal config template -> deliver by Thu COB.
- Novamed (Carla): confirm preferred payment terms (Net-45/Net-30), preferred tax_jurisdiction format, and currency.

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Thu 9am PT in case we need a walk-through of the mapping.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_field_mapping_example.csv, ariba_registration_instructions.pdf
